label: KarooTopoMaps
description: Custom high-contrast topographic map styles for Hammerhead Karoo devices. Switch between 9 handcrafted map styles directly on your Karoo.
releaseNotes: v1.1.2: Added granular surface & track grade (grade1-5) rendering for Gravel theme, added OpenAndroMaps network relation support (EuroVelo, National, Regional, Local cycle networks) with high-contrast route underlays across themes.
